scope: For a probability law supported on countably many measurable points with masses p_s, the self-information I(S;S), defined as KL divergence of the diagonal joint law from the product of its marginals, equals Shannon entropy sum_{p_s>0} p_s log(1/p_s), with nonnegative extended values allowing positive infinity.
